nameForms.name: King of Pamplona
nameForms.note: Original royal style of the Jiménez kings of Pamplona.
nameForms.noteCn: 希梅内斯王朝潘普洛纳国王的早期王号。

nameForms.name: King of Navarre
nameForms.note: Style adopted by Sancho VI around 1162, when the kingdom was increasingly called Navarre.
nameForms.noteCn: 桑乔六世约 1162 年起采用的称号，此后王国通常称纳瓦拉。

holders.note: Founded the Jiménez dynasty; first of the line to rule Pamplona.
holders.noteCn: 建立希梅内斯王朝，为该世系首位潘普洛纳国王。

holders.note: Succeeded his father García Sánchez I.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲加西亚·桑切斯一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Sancho II; known as 'the Tremulous'.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲桑乔二世，人称“颤抖者”。

holders.note: Succeeded his father García Sánchez II; ruled the largest Pamplonese realm.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲加西亚·桑切斯二世，统治疆域最大的潘普洛纳王国。

holders.note: Succeeded his father García Sánchez III; assassinated in 1076.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲加西亚·桑切斯三世，1076 年遇害。

holders.note: After Sancho IV's death in 1076, the kingdom entered a personal union under the kings of Aragon.
holders.noteCn: 1076 年桑乔四世死后，王国进入阿拉贡国王统治，与阿拉贡形成联合王权。

holders.note: King of Aragon and Navarre; succeeded his father Sancho Ramírez.
holders.noteCn: 阿拉贡与纳瓦拉国王，继承父亲桑乔·拉米雷斯。

holders.note: King of Aragon and Navarre; succeeded his brother Peter I.
holders.noteCn: 阿拉贡与纳瓦拉国王，继承兄长彼得一世。

holders.note: Restored an independent Navarrese kingship in 1134 after Alfonso I's death.
holders.noteCn: 阿方索一世去世后，1134 年恢复独立纳瓦拉王权。

holders.note: Succeeded his father García IV; adopted the title King of Navarre around 1162.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲加西亚四世，约 1162 年正式采用“纳瓦拉国王”称号。

holders.note: Succeeded Sancho VII through the hereditary right of his mother Blanche of Navarre, marking the transition to the Blois-Champagne line.
holders.noteCn: 经其母布兰奇（纳瓦拉）的继承权继位，标志王位转入布卢瓦-香槟支系。

holders.note: Succeeded Henry I as queen regnant.
holders.noteCn: 作为在位女王继承亨利一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his mother Joan I as Louis I of Navarre.
holders.noteCn: 作为纳瓦拉的路易一世继承母亲琼一世。
